name: Microgrid common-alarm external interface
aliases: microgrids Microgrid supervisory and communication interfaces
summary: Provides the defined alarm summary to an external supervisory system while preserving local detail.
description: Provides the defined alarm summary to an external supervisory system while preserving local detail. Microgrid supervision coordinates measurements, control authority and resource communication without replacing local protection. Each resource value needs a named measurement boundary, freshness condition and intended control use.

In a microgrid control room, the operator can see source availability, active constraints and current operating mode. A communication failure should remain distinguishable from an electrical resource failure. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Assigned microgrid alarm group” at the input and “External common-alarm output” at the output. A summary alarm is not a diagnosis.
